relatives.means: This means that during your stay in the museum, if the app identifies a relative who is related to you through your Geni family family tree you built, the app will show both of you that you are currently in the museum and give you both an option to meet or correspond with this relative.

top.headline: Museum of the Jewish People
top.question: Wouldn’t it be great to know if you have a family connection to famous Jewish people like Albert Einstein, Dona Gracia or Theodor Herzl?
top.whatToDo: Here's what you need to do in order to discover that and where they are located in the museum:

middle.login: Log in to your Geni account
middle.instructions: Once you're in, you'll see a list of famous people you're connected to and the relationship path for each one. A click on each person will reveal the exact location in the museum. You may even find your relationship to other museum visitors!

bottom.anotherPlatform: Have a family tree on another platform?
bottom.uploadGedcom: Upload your Gedcom file to Geni and connect to the World Family Tree (Available only on desktop).
bottom.invitedToDesk: You are invited to our Database Desk in order to register and build your own family tree. The more family members included the greater chance you'll find more connections at the museum.
